- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/01/17 (Tue) 10:56
- [FACT] User inquired about the pigment responsible for the yellow color of lemons.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The pigment that gives yellow color to lemons is called limonin.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Limonin is a flavonoid, which is a type of plant pigment.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Limonin is responsible for the yellow, orange, and red colors of many fruits and vegetables.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Limonin is present in the peel and outer layers of the lemon.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Limonin is responsible for the bright yellow color of the fruit.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Lemons are also rich in other pigments, such as carotenoids and flavonols, which contribute to their yellow color.
